name: humble-task-force
description: Humble Task Force — product-owner↔manager↔developer pipeline with two review gates: /draft-brief (Product Owner frames a feature's intent), /read-brief (Manager absorbs it + plans the build), /draft-ticket (draft against the brief), /review-ticket (Gate 1: Product Owner signs off the plan), /start-ticket (walkthrough + Q&A training, then plan, then build), /handoff (report from the real diff), /manager-review (Gate 2: check the PR against acceptance criteria), plus a bug loop — /report-bug (tester files a clean, labelled bug issue with screenshot) and /fetch-bug (developer validates it against the code and fixes it) — and /draft-prd, /draft-architecture, /setup-tickets.
